results.k06_finding: k06 is unchanged. Its hot loop is unrolled by 2, with loads at ptr-4 and ptr+0 and then ptr+=8. The int version of that loop is not post-incremented either, so the float type restriction was not the k06 bottleneck. Only a cold -O3 path changes (p.lw rr form).
